title: Chapter 984
text:
The Kunde Race war took place in the Flickering World, and the dynasty kept the process of the war a secret. Thus, this matter did not cause much of a stir in the explored universe, and not many people cared about it.

Only a few special organizations were paying attention to it.

Primeval Star River, Three King Planet.

This was one of the landmarks of the Primeval Star River and the capital planet of the Modo Civilization.

The Modo Civilization was also known as the Modo Three King Federation, one of the four Supercluster Civilizations that controlled the Primeval Star River.

The Three King Federation referred to the Modo Civilization's national situation, dating back to the exploration era.

At that time, the main race of the Modo Civilization was still the Modo people. During the exploration era war, the Modo people tried to swallow the other two powerful civilizations by force. However, they did not have the strength that the dynasty had against the Kunde Race, so they could only slowly devour them.

The war dragged on for a very long time, and all three parties had other enemies eyeing them from the outside. Under the internal and external threats, the three parties chose to stop the war and make concessions. The strongest Modo did not need to return all the territories they had conquered.

Thus, the borders of the three parties connected, and after they resumed trade and daily life, the races of the three parties started to live together, showing signs of integration.

After that, the situation of the exploration era war became more and more dangerous. The Modo people and their two old rivals felt the strain, and because their territories were close, the three parties protected each other's backs. After a long discussion, they finally decided to form an alliance and help each other, hoping to survive the dangerous exploration era war.

As the flames of war spread, the three parties gradually expanded outward, and their territories, technology, economy, and military all reached the Star Cluster level. Furthermore, none of the three parties were xenophobic. During the long war, the situation of racial integration became more and more obvious, and the upper echelons also intermarried to a certain extent.

If this continued, the three parties might become like the three Universal Civilizations, working together and scheming against each other. However, they were not the winners of the exploration era and could only listen to the rules of the three Universal Civilizations. No one was allowed to fight.

After the war ended, what followed was the splitting of the benefits. The surviving advanced civilizations of the various Star Fields finally started to establish order. In order to establish their position in the new era, every advanced civilization became extremely active in the diplomatic and political arena.

At that time, there were three Supercluster civilizations that were the strongest in the Primeval Star River. The Modo Civilization and the other two civilizations were only at the Star Cluster level and did not have the qualifications to become the Star Field Manager.

The three families thought about it. Since you slept with my older brother and I married your older sister, they were basically one family. Their territories were connected, and their races were integrated quite well. Then, they might as well merge. This way, they would have a chance to obtain the title of Supercluster Civilization, and they would have a lot more say.

When the other Star Cluster civilizations heard this, they immediately objected. Oh, since the three of you want to merge, should we merge too? Isn't this cheating!?

Peaceful merging of civilizations was rare, but it was not unheard of in the exploration era.

Peaceful merging required a foundation, and the three families of the Modo Civilization happened to have the qualifications to do so. The three of them had maintained a political alliance for many years, and their races were also highly integrated. The mixed-blood population made up twenty-four percent of the total population, and their economy and culture were very well integrated.

In the end, after a series of complicated operations, the Modo Civilization's merger application was approved by the three tyrants. This established the rule of three leaders representing their respective Star Cluster Civilizations, and the number of Supercluster Civilizations in the Primeval Star River increased to four. The Modo Civilization fulfilled their wish of becoming the Star Field Manager.

After developing to this point, the Modo Civilization had completely stabilized their qualifications to be a Supercluster Civilization. They were one of the strongest civilizations in the explored universe.

At this moment, on the capital planet, the three kings of the Modo Civilization were gathered together, listening to a report.

"… Intelligence shows that the dynasty has recalled their troops, which means that the natives have been dealt with. After 116 days, the dynasty's casualties are minimal."

There was only one figure in the conference room. A mixed-blood upper echelon wearing an official uniform stood in the middle of the room and read the report to the projection of the three kings on the virtual screen.

He was thin and sinister, and his entire person was emitting a gloomy and cold aura.

This person was called Madi, an upper echelon of the Modo Civilization. He was in charge of espionage and secret operations.

Like the other Supercluster Civilizations, the Modo Civilization had also sent stowaways to the Flickering World, and Madi was the person in charge of this project.

The plan to use the Kunde Race to destroy the Red Empire was proposed by him, and the plan to send the stowaways to the Red Empire was also decided by him.

"Those natives are too useless. They can't even cause the dynasty to lose more troops." One of the leaders shook his head.

"Natives are just natives, after all. We can't expect too much from them." Madi was expressionless.

The life and death of the Kunde Race were not within his consideration. They were just a tool to be used.

"What's your next plan?"

"I have already gotten the stowaways in the Flickering World to continue exploring and find the next native civilization that we can use," Madi said calmly. "With this native as an example, the other Supercluster Civilizations will copy our actions. Not only will we create more trouble for the dynasty, but we can also use the dynasty to eliminate our future competitors."

"Oh, it's best not to let the dynasty find out that we were the ones who planned this."

Another leader said in a low voice.

"Don't worry, Your Excellencies." A cold smile appeared on Madi's face. "I have already made arrangements. The dynasty won't find out who did it."

…

A few days later, the dynasty troops finally returned to Planet Lighthouse with the Kunde Race. The upper echelons of the dynasty also decided on a plan and informed Han Xiao about it.

"The dynasty has decided to place the Kunde Race in your territory for cultural transformation. During this period, they will be cut off from the Galactic Society, and you will be in charge of them."

Tarrokov brought this good news through the communicator, and Han Xiao, who was teasing Philip, smiled.

"Alright, leave it to me. Thank the Ruler for me."

Han Xiao nodded. Such a decision meant that the dynasty had balanced the opinions of the various parties and was willing to let him obtain the resources of the Kunde Race. Uranril's opinion definitely played a key role in this.

This way, the first requirement of the mission is basically fulfilled … Han Xiao mumbled to himself.

"Hmm, there will be someone who will contact your Black Star Corps." Tarrokov nodded and changed the topic. "There's something else that I have to tell you. The dynasty is currently investigating the mastermind behind using the Kunde Race, but there are very few clues. The spaceship that crashed was a common model, and we are unable to find its serial number. We have to first find the stowaways who dropped the spaceship, and we might need your help in this regard."

"Of course." Han Xiao's eyes lit up. He was more than willing to help out in this matter.

Finding the identity of the mastermind was a prerequisite for completing the mission. The group of stowaways had probably escaped to the unexplored Star Field, and finding them was no different from finding a needle in a haystack.

In this regard, he would probably have to ask Aesop for help.

While the mission description was vague, he was certain that the dynasty's sanctions alone would not be able to fulfill the second requirement of the mission. In the end, he would still have to rely on himself.

This means that I will have to go up against a Star Cluster or even a Supercluster …

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

Of course, there would be danger, but it was not without an advantage. After all, the three Universal Civilizations loved to bully these Supercluster the most.

Thus, it might not be a problem if I go overboard … Han Xiaoxin thought to himself.

"By the way, the live broadcast of the upper echelons of the Kunde Race is about to begin. They will mention you. Do you want to watch it together?"

"Sure."

Han Xiao put away his thoughts and nodded.

…

At the same time, on the Kunde Race flagship …

A member of the Dynasty's Intelligence Bureau wearing a red military uniform and black gloves walked into the cell of the Kunde Race leader and threw down a document.

The Kunde Race leader, who was resting against the wall, slowly opened his eyes and picked up the document in front of him.

He read it carefully, then closed the document and said slowly, "I'm not sure.

"Is this the ending you have prepared for me? I will cooperate well."

"I know, but we still need some insurance." The dynasty intelligence officer pressed down on the head of the Kunde Race leader and planted a psychic bomb.

This would not affect the independent consciousness of the Kunde Race leader, but it could be remotely controlled to prevent him from changing his mind.

"I have already made an agreement with His Excellency Black Star and will not act recklessly. This is unnecessary."

The Kunde Race leader shook his head.

The dynasty intelligence officer did not reply and said with a deep voice, "Follow me. It's time. The live broadcast is ready."

Letting out a breath, the Kunde Race leader stood up and tidied his clothes.

After tidying up for a full minute and ensuring that there was no trace of dust on his clothes, he raised his head and walked out of the cell to welcome his death.
